items.scope: All Snow Software products.
SoftIron HyperCloud branded products and technologies only.

All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in supported Ivanti products and infrastructure, excluding third-party components, and meeting severity thresholds defined in Ivanti’s Disclosure Policy found here.

All Schneider Electric products, including Proface, APC, and ProLeiT.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Kubernetes issues only.

Pegasystems products only.
Vulnerabilities in OpenAI installed software including desktop apps, mobile apps, and SDKs only.

All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.

All CrowdStrike products.
All BlackBerry products identified on https://www.blackberry.com/us/en.

Yugabyte products only.
Mautic core and officially supported plugins.
All HiddenLayer systems, services, and products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by HiddenLayer that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Forcepoint products only.
All Acronis products, including Acronis Cyber Protect, Acronis Cyber Protect Home Office, Acronis DeviceLock DLP, and Acronis Snap Deploy.

All Rapid7 products, and vulnerabilities discovered by Rapid7 that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities related to products of Mitsubishi Electric Group.

SailPoint issues only.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.

All products of Medtronic or a Medtronic company including supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered in Medtronic products that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Current versions of LINE Messenger Application for iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows, plus LINE Open Source projects hosted on https://github.com/line.
Zscaler issues only.
Omron Group companies’ Industrial Automation, Healthcare, Social Systems, Device & Module Solutions issues only.
All Network Optix products, including https://www.networkoptix.com/nx-witness and https://www.networkoptix.com/powered-by-nx.
Adobe issues only.
